reviewed_by: Codex focused review of harness Core-goal blocking, continuation guard, and product guidance
reason: Eight collected Python cases cover active-turn goal scoping, saved block state, automatic continuation limits, native tool activity, queued follow-up behavior, and bundled product-help digest/search/sync. Three collected real-Core browser cases exercise the harness-goal journey through the production UI on a disposable LAN Core in desktop Chromium, mobile Chromium, and mobile WebKit.
exclusions: No frontend component or native implementation changed, so their unit suites are excluded. Unrelated Python and browser journeys are excluded. Browser tests use inert harness fixtures and emulated mobile profiles; no physical device is available.
